verdict.rationale: SerpApi provides a single API for the 'search' step, including LLM-friendly markdown output (serpapi-docs-3, serpapi-docs-11) and an MCP server for agent integration (serpapi-probe-4), but there is no evidence it performs content extraction from result URLs or synthesis of findings — it returns search result snippets/structured data only, not full page content or summarized synthesis. missing for 10: content-extraction from linked pages, synthesis/summarization capability, an end-to-end documented example chaining search→extract→synthesize in one API call.
